responsibility: Implements the HIR walk that emits privacy diagnostics for actual uses of items and types. Using name-resolution results, type-check information, and stored ModuleVisibility mappings, it traverses expressions, statements, modules, functions, and selected item forms to determine whether referenced definitions or nested component types are accessible from the current module context, and reports "definition is private in this context" when use sites violate resolved visibility rules.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the privacy reporter: unlike rust-privacy-reporter.h, it contains the actual HIR traversal and checks that resolve referenced names/types against stored ModuleVisibility and emit "definition is private in this context" diagnostics.
